income_measurement.realized_reason: Payroll issuance is verified, but gross and payment proof remain behind the user's authenticated payroll portal; missing evidence is not converted to zero.
income_measurement.contracted_reason: No accepted assignments beyond 2026-08-11 or binding event assignments were read back.
income_measurement.pipeline_reason: No new paid-work contact, authenticated event inventory, or accepted assignment was observed. Three current marketplace candidates were hard-gated and none had a binding value/feasibility combination worth an application.

historical_capacity.interpretation: The direct 18-shift path is feasible but is not supported as the central case without changed availability or assignment supply.

primary_safe_path.activation_gate: Current physically safe, non-overlapping jobs from exactly one already-authenticated existing event source must be read back and personally accepted; up to two jobs must display combined gross of at least JPY 20,800.

direct_employment_path.historical_observation: At least 18 unique assigned dates occurred in 1 of 12 observed pay periods.

achievement_days.definition: Days until verified trailing-30-day gross income or a binding next-30-day gross run rate is at least JPY 200,000.

rationale.p20: First target-period verification around 2026-09-25 if the availability intervention yields 18 primary shifts or the conditional 16-plus-2 hybrid is activated.
rationale.p50: One additional pay-period cycle, verified around 2026-10-25, because 18 shifts occurred in only 1 of 12 observed periods and current event inventory is unverified.
rationale.p80: Allows roughly three additional monthly cycles and continued source substitution through late December if assignment supply stays near the recent 13-shift mean.
rationale.calibration_note: The prior forecast assumed 18 distributed shifts as the central path before twelve-period capacity was measured. This update lengthens the quantified forecast instead of preserving an unsupported optimistic assumption.
rationale.conditional_shortening: A current safe read-back from exactly one already-authenticated event source and up to two accepted jobs totaling at least JPY 20,800 can restore the first-cycle hybrid path. Two dormant registered sources reduce single-provider dependency but are not yet counted in the quantiles.
rationale.current_run_note: P20/P50/P80 remain 44/74/135 days. The advertised JPY 30,000-50,000 candidate had no binding scope or compensation; a trusted listing in the same headline range was only a JPY 500 screening; a trusted ChatGPT image task would require thousands of images to close the gap.

maintenance_confirmation_days.definition: Two measurements at least 30 days apart are each at least JPY 200,000, with evidence that the following 30 days continue.

priority_paths.path: existing employment plus formally hired event-staff hybrid
priority_paths.action: Request a safe four-primary-day weekly pattern and personally accept at most two non-overlapping event jobs from exactly one already-authenticated existing source only when their combined displayed gross is at least JPY 20,800 and every safety gate passes.
priority_paths.dependency: Sixteen accepted primary shifts, current inventory from one already-authenticated existing event source, safe commute, and user acceptance.

priority_paths.action: Keep requesting a safe 4–5 day-shift weekly pattern; count only accepted assignments.
priority_paths.dependency: Eighteen accepted day shifts; observed once in twelve pay periods.

priority_paths.action: Search only verified clients or warm contacts with fixed paid deliverables, stated quantity, smartphone-proven workflow, and net value that beats one existing day shift or reliably closes the JPY 20,800 hybrid gap.
priority_paths.dependency: No current marketplace candidate passed the binding compensation, client trust, smartphone feasibility, and effective-value gates.

priority_paths.role: Optional upside, not the critical path without demand or conversion evidence.

minimum_user_operation.cadence: one batched phone session this week
steps: In the normal shift form, submit only physically safe dates for the week beginning 2026-08-16, aiming for four primary day shifts with rest; keep requesting toward sixteen accepted primary shifts in the pay period.
In the same Gmail session, open the unread 2026-07-24 payroll notice, tap its payroll link, and read only gross pay.

Inspect exactly one event source that is already authenticated: use the formally hired app first; only if it is unavailable and the previously used registered-staff web portal is already logged in, use that portal instead. Do not install, recover credentials, or re-register. Personally apply to at most two non-overlapping jobs only when they are physically safe, commute and return are safe, and combined displayed gross is at least JPY 20,800. Otherwise do not apply and report no eligible job or no authenticated source.
minimum_user_operation.minimization_reason: The fallback is substitution, not an additional login: at most one already-authenticated event source is inspected inside the same weekly phone session.
minimum_user_operation.secret_warning: Do not send screenshots, credentials, verification codes, payslip contents other than gross pay, addresses, or identifiers.
minimum_user_operation.completion_signal: Return only '総支給額=金額／現職4勤務希望済み／イベント応募=件数・合計金額' or 'イベント対象なし' or '認証済みイベント経路なし'.

biggest_uncertainties: User physical availability and safe workload
Employer acceptance of requested primary shifts
Current event-app inventory, gross, commute, and acceptance
Gross amount and payment proof behind the authenticated payroll portal
The separate effects of user availability and employer supply in historical shift counts
Whether dormant registered event-work accounts remain authenticated and show current safe inventory
Whether a current marketplace listing can state binding scope and pay while remaining smartphone-completable
privacy: No employer name, person name, coworker, address, email, phone, account identifier, message identifier, or secret is stored.

selected_order: formally hired existing app if already authenticated
registered web portal backup if already authenticated and the first source is unavailable
registered_event_backups.deferred_source: An older personalized email/SMS route remains outside the current weekly bundle pending a fresh current-status signal.
registered_event_backups.excluded_source: A registration-selection reservation without completion evidence is not treated as registered.
